title: Tech Note: Web Assistant for Dummies

historical_commentary.text: The 4D Web Assistant was a no-code/low-code tool aimed at letting non-programmers publish 4D data to the web during the dot-com-boom era, well before REST APIs, ORDA, or modern JS front ends existed. The Web Assistant product itself has long since been discontinued and its wizard-driven approach to web publishing bears little resemblance to how 4D applications expose data to the web today (4D's built-in REST/ORDA data server, Qodly, and standard web frameworks), making this note of historical interest only.
related_updates: 4D's Web Assistant tool was discontinued long ago and has no direct modern equivalent
Publishing 4D data to the web today is typically done via 4D's REST/ORDA data server, Qodly, or custom web frameworks rather than a wizard-driven assistant
